meta.interval: clock (days): 80% (10th-90th percentile) of the estimate. Measures (patients, deaths): Range, not a probability interval: lowest and highest value when every effect size and conversion assumption is moved together from its lower bound to its upper bound. The point estimate uses the published or central values.
meta.care_path_interval: exact binomial 95% interval from the county's own counts; funnel limits 95% and 99.8% around the national share

inputs.parameters: real (12 fields mapped: steps.patient, steps.primary, steps.referral, steps.diagnosis, steps.treatment, benchmarks, specialist_floor, hazard_per_4w, curative_share, survival_5y.early, survival_5y.late, measured_hospital_times(0 usable))

notes: measured_hospital_times: Tyks (Turku University Hospital) has no value the evidence agent could open (left empty rather than filled from memory): its steps stay estimated

National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.
meta.incidence_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
meta.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
meta.benchmark_floor_en: Patient and primary care steps: not below 43% of the national median (best Nordic total 67 days / Finnish 155 days). Referral, diagnosis and treatment steps: not below 72% of the national median (best Nordic standard time referral to treatment 42 days, NO_pakkeforlop_lung, / Finnish 58 days).

area.patients_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
area.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
area.curative_gap_note_en: 30 new patients a year x (30.4% - 22.3%) = 2.4 patients a year. 30.4% is the share reached by the best quarter of counties (2019-2023); patients = new lung cancers 2019-2023 / 5. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness.

stages.quote: Kuva 13: Keuhkosyöpäpotilaiden levinneisyysluokitus hyvinvointialueittain | Ei tietoa | Osuus potilaista (%)
stages.note_en: 100 minus the share with no stage information. A recording measure: it says how complete the registry's stage data is, not how well patients were staged. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about two percentage points, so no interval is given.

stages.quote: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 2 | 148 | 1.4
stages.note_en: A recording measure, not a measure of care: MDT meetings are picked from the hospital discharge register by two procedure codes (WZC15, WZC20), which most hospitals do not record. A low share says the meeting is not coded, not that it did not happen.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 33 | 148 | 22.3
stages.note_en: Patients with surgery, stereotactic radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy within 12 months of diagnosis, of all patients diagnosed 2019-2023. Not adjusted for age, stage or other illness.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Leikkaushoito | Keski-Pohjanmaan | 11,5 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Leikkaushoito | Keski-Pohjanmaan | 32,6
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are from the registry's own 95% confidence intervals for men and women (normal approximation).
stages.registry_ci_read_by: claude (read from the PDF page images on 2026-11-13; percentages agree with the rows Gemini read from the same table)

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Sädehoito | Keski-Pohjanmaan | 26,6 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Sädehoito | Keski-Pohjanmaan | 27,6
stages.note_en: Any radiotherapy, curative or palliative. Curative (stereotactic) radiotherapy is published for the whole country only (11.2% of patients 2019-2023), not by county. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Lääkehoito | Keski-Pohjanmaan | 31,2 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Lääkehoito | Keski-Pohjanmaan | 39,3
stages.note_en: Drug treatment is under-recorded in the national registers: only treatment given at a hospital contact is captured. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 48 | 148 | 32.4
stages.note_en: Drug therapy or radiotherapy that slows the cancer. Treatment groups overlap: one patient can be in several.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 69 | 148 | 46.6
stages.note_en: Palliative care recorded. Treatment groups overlap.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 37 | 148 | 25.0
stages.note_en: No treatment of any kind found in the registers within 12 months. This mixes patients who were not treated with patients whose treatment was not recorded; public data cannot tell them apart.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.label_en: Days from diagnosis to first treatment
stages.quote: TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Leikkaushoito | Mediaani 13,5 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Sädehoito | Mediaani 31,0 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Lääkehoito | Mediaani 42,0
stages.note_en: Not a county value. The registry publishes median days by collaborative area and treatment type only; this is the Northern Finland (OYS) area's three medians (surgery 13.5, radiotherapy 31, drug therapy 42) weighted by the national treatment mix, so every county in the area shows the same number. Only patients treated within 6 months are counted. No interval is published; rank is among the five collaborative areas (1 = longest).

stages.quote: Kuva 20: Ikäkorjattu elossaolo-osuus sukupuolittain ja hyvinvointialueittain; Keski-Pohjanmaan hva, Mies, Kuukausia seurannan alusta 12
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share alive 12 months after diagnosis; published by sex, the value is the mean of men and women. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about one percentage point, so no interval or limits are given. Survival follows stage at diagnosis and age as well as treatment.

care_path.rank_note_en: Rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side (for context stages: the lowest value).
care_path.limits_note_en: outside_limits compares the county with the national share: 'none' = inside the range chance alone gives a county of this size 95% of the time; '95' = outside it; '99.8' = outside the range chance gives 998 times in 1,000. Counties differ more than chance on most stages, so being outside the limits shows a real difference, not its cause.

artefact_flags.text_en: The median wait for surgery in the Northern Finland (OYS) area is 13.5 days, but the lower quartile is 0: for at least a quarter of operated patients the cancer was diagnosed at the operation itself. The short median reflects how the diagnosis date is set, not fast care.
artefact_flags.text_fi: Leikkaukseen pääsyn mediaani yhteistyöalueella on 13,5 päivää, mutta alakvartiili on 0: vähintään joka neljännellä leikatulla syöpä todettiin vasta leikkauksessa. Lyhyt mediaani kertoo diagnoosipäivän määrittelystä, ei nopeasta hoidosta.

artefact_flags.text_en: The MDT share counts two procedure codes that most hospitals do not record (6% nationally). It measures coding, not whether cases are discussed.
artefact_flags.text_fi: MDT-osuus perustuu kahteen toimenpidekoodiin, joita useimmat sairaalat eivät kirjaa (koko maassa 6 %). Luku kuvaa kirjaamista, ei sitä, käsitelläänkö potilaat kokouksessa.

main_leak.sentence_en: Of 100 lung cancer patients in Central Ostrobothnia, 22 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size.
main_leak.sentence_fi: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueella sadasta keuhkosyöpäpotilaasta 22 saa parantavaan pyrkivää hoitoa. Koko Suomessa luku on 27. Ero mahtuu tämän kokoisen alueen satunnaisvaihteluun.

by_modality.note_en: 30 patients a year x (national operated share 15% - this county's 22.1%), capped at the total. Operated shares are the registry's age-standardised 6-month figures for 2018-mid 2022 (mean of men and women), a different period than the total.

The rest: total minus the surgery part. Nationally the curative treatments other than surgery are stereotactic radiotherapy (11.2% of patients) and chemoradiotherapy (0.9%); neither is published by county, so this part is by subtraction, not measured.

missing_patients.split_method_en: Surgery part from the county's operated share against the national one; the remainder is assigned to curative radiotherapy by subtraction.
missing_patients.note_en: 30 new patients a year x (27% nationally - 22.3% here) = 1.4 patients a year (0-3.3 from the exact 95% interval of the county's share). Against the share reached by the best quarter of counties (30.4%) it is 2.4 a year. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness, and the registry cannot say which of these patients could have been treated to cure.

headroom.note_en: Patients a year between this county's curative share and the share of the best quarter of counties.

expected.method_en: Expected share = what a county with this share of residents aged 65 or over would have if it followed the pattern of the other 21 counties (quasi-binomial regression of curative-intent counts on the county's 65+ share, fitted without the county itself). Ratio = observed / expected; the interval allows for counties varying 4.1 times more than chance alone. This is an ecological adjustment: it uses the age of the county's residents, not of its patients, because the registry publishes neither the national share by age nor the age of each county's patients. It can remove an age-structure difference between counties; it cannot show why a county differs.
adjusted_for: share of county residents aged 65 or over (Statistics Finland, county level)
not_adjusted_for: stage at diagnosis (unknown for 48% of patients nationally, so it cannot be used)
how the cancer was found (symptoms, incidental, emergency)
treatment given outside the county's own records
expected.distance_en: Distance to the university hospital is reported, not adjusted away, because distance is part of access to treatment. Across counties the curative share falls with distance (Spearman rho -0.66, permutation p 0.000); after the 65+ adjustment the link is rho -0.30 (p 0.18). Distance and age structure go together in Finland, so 22 counties cannot separate them.
expected.why_not_standardised_en: Indirect standardisation by age and stage was not possible: the registry's public report gives the curative share for all patients only, not by age group or stage, and stage is unknown for 48% of patients.

registry_age_standardised_surgery.note_en: The registry's own adjustment, for surgery only: operated share standardised to the age of all Finnish patients (four age groups), by sex, with its 95% confidence interval. Where the interval lies below the national share, age does not explain the county's lower operated share.

expected.sentence_en: Observed 22.3%, expected 26.4% for a county with 25.3% of residents aged 65+: ratio 0.85 (0.48-1.48). Within the range the county's age structure predicts.

18.clock_note_en: Secondary view. The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: steps 1-4 are national figures scaled by public county indicators with assumed effect sizes; only diagnosis to treatment is measured, per collaborative area. Days saved is not a headline number.

mortality_vs_incidence.sentence_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in Central Ostrobothnia is 0.83 times the national rate (29.74 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 0.87 times (40.77 vs 46.98). The lower mortality goes with fewer people getting lung cancer here. Small numbers: 122 deaths in five years, so the rate is uncertain.

steps.label_en: First symptom to first primary care contact
steps.method_en: National median for this step (56.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 6 of 6 indicators available for this county (forgone_care_due_to_money_pct, daily_smokers_pct, low_income_rate_pct, education_level_index, crc_screening_participation_pct, sparse_rural_pop_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

steps.label_en: First primary care contact to referral
steps.method_en: National median for this step (41.0 days; reported) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 4 of 4 indicators available for this county (primary_care_wait_over_7d_pct, primary_care_wait_over_3m_pct, nurse_wait_over_7d_pct, continuity_of_care_coci). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.rationale_en: Each GP visit in the work-up waits in the same queue.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent GP visits with a wait over 3 months
drivers.rationale_en: Very long GP waits mark the worst-served areas.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent nurse visits with a wait over 7 days
drivers.rationale_en: Nurse triage is often the first contact.

drivers.label_en: Continuity of care (COCI) in primary care physician visits
drivers.rationale_en: Seeing the same doctor makes a persisting symptom easier to recognise.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (9.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 2 of 3 indicators available for this county (pulmonology_referrals_handled_over_21d_pct, specialist_wait_over_6m_per_10k). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Referrals processed in more than 21 days (pulmonary diseases)
drivers.rationale_en: Slow referral processing delays every booking.

drivers.label_en: Waited over 6 months for specialist care, per 10,000 inhabitants
drivers.rationale_en: General congestion of specialist care in the area.

queue.method_en: Standing queue: service rate equals arrivals (backlog neither grows nor shrinks) and backlog / service rate reproduces the estimated wait. Only added capacity shortens it.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (12.1 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 3 of 3 indicators available for this county (pulmonology_queue_over_90d_pct, km_to_university_hospital, lung_mdt_recorded_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.rationale_en: A recorded MDT decision is a marker of an organised diagnostic process.

queue.method_en: Standing queue: service rate equals arrivals (backlog neither grows nor shrinks) and backlog / service rate reproduces the estimated wait. Only added capacity shortens it.

steps.method_en: Measured for the collaborative area, not the county: Finnish Cancer Registry median days from diagnosis to first treatment in the Northern Finland (OYS) collaborative area, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022 (patients treated within 6 months): surgery 13.5, radiotherapy 31, drug therapy 42. Combined with the county treatment mix (surgery 22.1%, radiotherapy 27.1%, drug therapy 35.2% of patients) = 31 days. The medians are measured for the collaborative area, not the county; the weighting is arithmetic. No interval is published per area.

consistency_check.what_en: Spearman rank correlation, across counties, between the estimated days from first symptom to diagnosis (steps 1-4) and three measured outcomes.

results.sentence_en: Expected direction: counties with a longer estimated wait have lower share treated with curative intent, moderately (rho -0.30, n 22, permutation p 0.17; could be chance).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in one-year survival (rho -0.04, n 22).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in age-standardised lung cancer mortality (rho +0.10, n 23).

consistency_check.summary_en: 0 of 3 outcomes correlate with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance. This is a check, not a validation: it is county-level, with about 22 points, and confounded by age, smoking and stage at diagnosis. The priors were not tuned to improve it.
consistency_check.caveat_en: A check, not a validation; county-level, confounded by age, smoking and stage.

18.total_method_en: National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.

meta.interval: clock (days): 80% (10th-90th percentile) of the estimate. Measures (patients, deaths): Range, not a probability interval: lowest and highest value when every effect size and conversion assumption is moved together from its lower bound to its upper bound. The point estimate uses the published or central values.
meta.care_path_interval: exact binomial 95% interval from the county's own counts; funnel limits 95% and 99.8% around the national share

inputs.parameters: real (12 fields mapped: steps.patient, steps.primary, steps.referral, steps.diagnosis, steps.treatment, benchmarks, specialist_floor, hazard_per_4w, curative_share, survival_5y.early, survival_5y.late, measured_hospital_times(0 usable))

notes: measured_hospital_times: Tyks (Turku University Hospital) has no value the evidence agent could open (left empty rather than filled from memory): its steps stay estimated

National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.
meta.incidence_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
meta.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
meta.benchmark_floor_en: Patient and primary care steps: not below 43% of the national median (best Nordic total 67 days / Finnish 155 days). Referral, diagnosis and treatment steps: not below 72% of the national median (best Nordic standard time referral to treatment 42 days, NO_pakkeforlop_lung, / Finnish 58 days).

area.patients_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
area.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
area.curative_gap_note_en: 210 new patients a year x (30.4% - 23.6%) = 14.2 patients a year. 30.4% is the share reached by the best quarter of counties (2019-2023); patients = new lung cancers 2019-2023 / 5. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness.

stages.quote: Kuva 13: Keuhkosyöpäpotilaiden levinneisyysluokitus hyvinvointialueittain | Ei tietoa | Osuus potilaista (%)
stages.note_en: 100 minus the share with no stage information. A recording measure: it says how complete the registry's stage data is, not how well patients were staged. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about two percentage points, so no interval is given.

stages.quote: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 12 | 1050 | 1.1
stages.note_en: A recording measure, not a measure of care: MDT meetings are picked from the hospital discharge register by two procedure codes (WZC15, WZC20), which most hospitals do not record. A low share says the meeting is not coded, not that it did not happen.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 248 | 1050 | 23.6
stages.note_en: Patients with surgery, stereotactic radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy within 12 months of diagnosis, of all patients diagnosed 2019-2023. Not adjusted for age, stage or other illness.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Leikkaushoito | Pohjois-Pohjanmaan | 14,2 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Leikkaushoito | Pohjois-Pohjanmaan | 16,9
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are from the registry's own 95% confidence intervals for men and women (normal approximation).
stages.registry_ci_read_by: claude (read from the PDF page images on 2026-11-13; percentages agree with the rows Gemini read from the same table)

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Sädehoito | Pohjois-Pohjanmaan | 26,6 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Sädehoito | Pohjois-Pohjanmaan | 28,7
stages.note_en: Any radiotherapy, curative or palliative. Curative (stereotactic) radiotherapy is published for the whole country only (11.2% of patients 2019-2023), not by county. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Lääkehoito | Pohjois-Pohjanmaan | 38,6 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Lääkehoito | Pohjois-Pohjanmaan | 42,7
stages.note_en: Drug treatment is under-recorded in the national registers: only treatment given at a hospital contact is captured. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 393 | 1050 | 37.4
stages.note_en: Drug therapy or radiotherapy that slows the cancer. Treatment groups overlap: one patient can be in several.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 407 | 1050 | 38.8
stages.note_en: Palliative care recorded. Treatment groups overlap.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue | 263 | 1050 | 25.0
stages.note_en: No treatment of any kind found in the registers within 12 months. This mixes patients who were not treated with patients whose treatment was not recorded; public data cannot tell them apart.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.label_en: Days from diagnosis to first treatment
stages.quote: TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Leikkaushoito | Mediaani 13,5 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Sädehoito | Mediaani 31,0 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Lääkehoito | Mediaani 42,0
stages.note_en: Not a county value. The registry publishes median days by collaborative area and treatment type only; this is the Northern Finland (OYS) area's three medians (surgery 13.5, radiotherapy 31, drug therapy 42) weighted by the national treatment mix, so every county in the area shows the same number. Only patients treated within 6 months are counted. No interval is published; rank is among the five collaborative areas (1 = longest).

stages.quote: Kuva 20: Ikäkorjattu elossaolo-osuus sukupuolittain ja hyvinvointialueittain; Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hva, Mies, Kuukausia seurannan alusta 12
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share alive 12 months after diagnosis; published by sex, the value is the mean of men and women. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about one percentage point, so no interval or limits are given. Survival follows stage at diagnosis and age as well as treatment.

care_path.rank_note_en: Rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side (for context stages: the lowest value).
care_path.limits_note_en: outside_limits compares the county with the national share: 'none' = inside the range chance alone gives a county of this size 95% of the time; '95' = outside it; '99.8' = outside the range chance gives 998 times in 1,000. Counties differ more than chance on most stages, so being outside the limits shows a real difference, not its cause.

artefact_flags.text_en: The median wait for surgery in the Northern Finland (OYS) area is 13.5 days, but the lower quartile is 0: for at least a quarter of operated patients the cancer was diagnosed at the operation itself. The short median reflects how the diagnosis date is set, not fast care.
artefact_flags.text_fi: Leikkaukseen pääsyn mediaani yhteistyöalueella on 13,5 päivää, mutta alakvartiili on 0: vähintään joka neljännellä leikatulla syöpä todettiin vasta leikkauksessa. Lyhyt mediaani kertoo diagnoosipäivän määrittelystä, ei nopeasta hoidosta.

artefact_flags.text_en: The MDT share counts two procedure codes that most hospitals do not record (6% nationally). It measures coding, not whether cases are discussed.
artefact_flags.text_fi: MDT-osuus perustuu kahteen toimenpidekoodiin, joita useimmat sairaalat eivät kirjaa (koko maassa 6 %). Luku kuvaa kirjaamista, ei sitä, käsitelläänkö potilaat kokouksessa.

main_leak.sentence_en: Of 100 lung cancer patients in North Ostrobothnia, 24 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 7 patients a year.
main_leak.sentence_fi: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueella sadasta keuhkosyöpäpotilaasta 24 saa parantavaan pyrkivää hoitoa. Koko Suomessa luku on 27. Ero on noin 7 potilasta vuodessa.
main_leak.basis_en: The stage where this county is furthest on the worse side of the national share, measured in units of chance variation for a county of its size. Stages with a recording flag are left out. A measured difference, not its cause.

by_modality.note_en: 210 patients a year x (national operated share 15% - this county's 15.5%), capped at the total. Operated shares are the registry's age-standardised 6-month figures for 2018-mid 2022 (mean of men and women), a different period than the total.

The rest: total minus the surgery part. Nationally the curative treatments other than surgery are stereotactic radiotherapy (11.2% of patients) and chemoradiotherapy (0.9%); neither is published by county, so this part is by subtraction, not measured.

missing_patients.split_method_en: Surgery part from the county's operated share against the national one; the remainder is assigned to curative radiotherapy by subtraction.
missing_patients.note_en: 210 new patients a year x (27% nationally - 23.6% here) = 7.1 patients a year (1.5-12.4 from the exact 95% interval of the county's share). Against the share reached by the best quarter of counties (30.4%) it is 14.2 a year. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness, and the registry cannot say which of these patients could have been treated to cure.

headroom.note_en: Patients a year between this county's curative share and the share of the best quarter of counties.

expected.method_en: Expected share = what a county with this share of residents aged 65 or over would have if it followed the pattern of the other 21 counties (quasi-binomial regression of curative-intent counts on the county's 65+ share, fitted without the county itself). Ratio = observed / expected; the interval allows for counties varying 4.1 times more than chance alone. This is an ecological adjustment: it uses the age of the county's residents, not of its patients, because the registry publishes neither the national share by age nor the age of each county's patients. It can remove an age-structure difference between counties; it cannot show why a county differs.
adjusted_for: share of county residents aged 65 or over (Statistics Finland, county level)
not_adjusted_for: stage at diagnosis (unknown for 48% of patients nationally, so it cannot be used)
how the cancer was found (symptoms, incidental, emergency)
treatment given outside the county's own records
expected.distance_en: Distance to the university hospital is reported, not adjusted away, because distance is part of access to treatment. Across counties the curative share falls with distance (Spearman rho -0.66, permutation p 0.000); after the 65+ adjustment the link is rho -0.30 (p 0.18). Distance and age structure go together in Finland, so 22 counties cannot separate them.
expected.why_not_standardised_en: Indirect standardisation by age and stage was not possible: the registry's public report gives the curative share for all patients only, not by age group or stage, and stage is unknown for 48% of patients.

registry_age_standardised_surgery.note_en: The registry's own adjustment, for surgery only: operated share standardised to the age of all Finnish patients (four age groups), by sex, with its 95% confidence interval. Where the interval lies below the national share, age does not explain the county's lower operated share.

expected.sentence_en: Observed 23.6%, expected 29.7% for a county with 21.9% of residents aged 65+: ratio 0.8 (0.66-0.95). Below what the county's age structure predicts.

19.clock_note_en: Secondary view. The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: steps 1-4 are national figures scaled by public county indicators with assumed effect sizes; only diagnosis to treatment is measured, per collaborative area. Days saved is not a headline number.

mortality_vs_incidence.sentence_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in North Ostrobothnia is 1.08 times the national rate (38.65 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 1.04 times (48.82 vs 46.98). Most of the mortality difference is already there in how many people get lung cancer; it does not by itself show worse results after diagnosis.

steps.label_en: First symptom to first primary care contact
steps.method_en: National median for this step (56.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 6 of 6 indicators available for this county (forgone_care_due_to_money_pct, daily_smokers_pct, low_income_rate_pct, education_level_index, crc_screening_participation_pct, sparse_rural_pop_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Had to cut back on food, medicines or doctor visits for lack of money
drivers.rationale_en: People who skip care for cost reasons present later.

drivers.label_en: Daily smokers, adults
drivers.rationale_en: Smokers tend to normalise a cough and wait longer before seeking help.

drivers.label_en: At-risk-of-poverty rate
drivers.rationale_en: Lower income is associated with later presentation.

drivers.label_en: Measure of educational level
drivers.rationale_en: Lower education carries higher odds of stage IV at diagnosis (Finnish registry study).

drivers.label_en: Colorectal cancer screening participation
drivers.rationale_en: Proxy for how readily residents take up health services.

drivers.label_en: Share living in sparsely populated rural areas
drivers.rationale_en: Long distances to the health centre raise the threshold to seek care.

steps.label_en: First primary care contact to referral
steps.method_en: National median for this step (41.0 days; reported) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 4 of 4 indicators available for this county (primary_care_wait_over_7d_pct, primary_care_wait_over_3m_pct, nurse_wait_over_7d_pct, continuity_of_care_coci). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent GP visits with a wait over 7 days from assessment of need
drivers.rationale_en: Each GP visit in the work-up waits in the same queue.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent GP visits with a wait over 3 months
drivers.rationale_en: Very long GP waits mark the worst-served areas.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent nurse visits with a wait over 7 days
drivers.rationale_en: Nurse triage is often the first contact.

drivers.label_en: Continuity of care (COCI) in primary care physician visits
drivers.rationale_en: Seeing the same doctor makes a persisting symptom easier to recognise.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (9.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 3 of 3 indicators available for this county (pulmonology_assessment_over_90d_pct, pulmonology_referrals_handled_over_21d_pct, specialist_wait_over_6m_per_10k). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Waiting for assessment of need for care over 90 days (pulmonary diseases)
drivers.rationale_en: Direct measure of the pulmonology first-visit queue (all diagnoses).

drivers.label_en: Referrals processed in more than 21 days (pulmonary diseases)
drivers.rationale_en: Slow referral processing delays every booking.

drivers.label_en: Waited over 6 months for specialist care, per 10,000 inhabitants
drivers.rationale_en: General congestion of specialist care in the area.

queue.method_en: Standing queue: service rate equals arrivals (backlog neither grows nor shrinks) and backlog / service rate reproduces the estimated wait. Only added capacity shortens it.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (12.1 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 3 of 3 indicators available for this county (pulmonology_queue_over_90d_pct, km_to_university_hospital, lung_mdt_recorded_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

data_gaps.what_en: Days from referral to first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer, by county
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The largest controllable wait; today only all-diagnosis queue shares are public.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Wellbeing services counties / THL (Hilmo already holds referral and visit dates)

data_gaps.what_en: Days from first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and diagnosis to treatment start by county (today: five collaborative areas only)
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Without it the model has to estimate where time is lost before diagnosis; the registry already publishes diagnosis to treatment per collaborative area.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: University and central hospitals; the national cancer centre (FICAN) quality registers

data_gaps.what_en: Stage, age and performance status of each county's patients (stage is unknown for 48% nationally), and the curative share by stage
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Would separate a gap in care from a difference in who gets ill. Today the adjustment can only use the age of the county's residents.

data_gaps.what_en: Stereotactic radiotherapy and chemoradiotherapy by county, and the reason when no treatment is on record
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The care path can split the missing curative patients into surgery and 'the rest' only by subtraction, and cannot tell an untreated patient from an unrecorded treatment.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Finnish Cancer Registry; the counties' own records

data_gaps.what_en: Date of first symptom or first primary care contact for cancer patients
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The patient and primary care intervals are the longest part of the pathway and are not recorded anywhere nationally.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Primary care records (Avohilmo) linked to the Cancer Registry by THL / Findata

consistency_check.what_en: Spearman rank correlation, across counties, between the estimated days from first symptom to diagnosis (steps 1-4) and three measured outcomes.

results.sentence_en: Expected direction: counties with a longer estimated wait have lower share treated with curative intent, moderately (rho -0.30, n 22, permutation p 0.17; could be chance).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in one-year survival (rho -0.04, n 22).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in age-standardised lung cancer mortality (rho +0.10, n 23).

consistency_check.summary_en: 0 of 3 outcomes correlate with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance. This is a check, not a validation: it is county-level, with about 22 points, and confounded by age, smoking and stage at diagnosis. The priors were not tuned to improve it.
consistency_check.caveat_en: A check, not a validation; county-level, confounded by age, smoking and stage.

19.total_method_en: National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.

meta.interval: clock (days): 80% (10th-90th percentile) of the estimate. Measures (patients, deaths): Range, not a probability interval: lowest and highest value when every effect size and conversion assumption is moved together from its lower bound to its upper bound. The point estimate uses the published or central values.
meta.care_path_interval: exact binomial 95% interval from the county's own counts; funnel limits 95% and 99.8% around the national share

inputs.parameters: real (12 fields mapped: steps.patient, steps.primary, steps.referral, steps.diagnosis, steps.treatment, benchmarks, specialist_floor, hazard_per_4w, curative_share, survival_5y.early, survival_5y.late, measured_hospital_times(0 usable))

notes: measured_hospital_times: Tyks (Turku University Hospital) has no value the evidence agent could open (left empty rather than filled from memory): its steps stay estimated

National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.
meta.incidence_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
meta.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
meta.benchmark_floor_en: Patient and primary care steps: not below 43% of the national median (best Nordic total 67 days / Finnish 155 days). Referral, diagnosis and treatment steps: not below 72% of the national median (best Nordic standard time referral to treatment 42 days, NO_pakkeforlop_lung, / Finnish 58 days).

area.patients_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
area.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
area.curative_gap_note_en: 45 new patients a year x (30.4% - 20.8%) = 4.3 patients a year. 30.4% is the share reached by the best quarter of counties (2019-2023); patients = new lung cancers 2019-2023 / 5. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness.

stages.quote: Kuva 13: Keuhkosyöpäpotilaiden levinneisyysluokitus hyvinvointialueittain | Ei tietoa | Osuus potilaista (%)
stages.note_en: 100 minus the share with no stage information. A recording measure: it says how complete the registry's stage data is, not how well patients were staged. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about two percentage points, so no interval is given.

stages.quote: Kainuun hyvinvointialue | 2 | 226 | 0.9
stages.note_en: A recording measure, not a measure of care: MDT meetings are picked from the hospital discharge register by two procedure codes (WZC15, WZC20), which most hospitals do not record. A low share says the meeting is not coded, not that it did not happen.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Kainuun hyvinvointialue | 47 | 226 | 20.8
stages.note_en: Patients with surgery, stereotactic radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy within 12 months of diagnosis, of all patients diagnosed 2019-2023. Not adjusted for age, stage or other illness.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Leikkaushoito | Kainuun | 5,1 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Leikkaushoito | Kainuun | 10,0
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are from the registry's own 95% confidence intervals for men and women (normal approximation).
stages.registry_ci_read_by: claude (read from the PDF page images on 2026-11-13; percentages agree with the rows Gemini read from the same table)

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Sädehoito | Kainuun | 31,6 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Sädehoito | Kainuun | 28,5
stages.note_en: Any radiotherapy, curative or palliative. Curative (stereotactic) radiotherapy is published for the whole country only (11.2% of patients 2019-2023), not by county. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Lääkehoito | Kainuun | 16,9 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Lääkehoito | Kainuun | 16,3
stages.note_en: Drug treatment is under-recorded in the national registers: only treatment given at a hospital contact is captured. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: Kainuun hyvinvointialue | 42 | 226 | 18.6
stages.note_en: Drug therapy or radiotherapy that slows the cancer. Treatment groups overlap: one patient can be in several.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Kainuun hyvinvointialue | 109 | 226 | 48.2
stages.note_en: Palliative care recorded. Treatment groups overlap.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Kainuun hyvinvointialue | 64 | 226 | 28.3
stages.note_en: No treatment of any kind found in the registers within 12 months. This mixes patients who were not treated with patients whose treatment was not recorded; public data cannot tell them apart.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.label_en: Days from diagnosis to first treatment
stages.quote: TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Leikkaushoito | Mediaani 13,5 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Sädehoito | Mediaani 31,0 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Lääkehoito | Mediaani 42,0
stages.note_en: Not a county value. The registry publishes median days by collaborative area and treatment type only; this is the Northern Finland (OYS) area's three medians (surgery 13.5, radiotherapy 31, drug therapy 42) weighted by the national treatment mix, so every county in the area shows the same number. Only patients treated within 6 months are counted. No interval is published; rank is among the five collaborative areas (1 = longest).

stages.quote: Kuva 20: Ikäkorjattu elossaolo-osuus sukupuolittain ja hyvinvointialueittain; Kainuun hva, Mies, Kuukausia seurannan alusta 12
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share alive 12 months after diagnosis; published by sex, the value is the mean of men and women. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about one percentage point, so no interval or limits are given. Survival follows stage at diagnosis and age as well as treatment.

care_path.rank_note_en: Rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side (for context stages: the lowest value).
care_path.limits_note_en: outside_limits compares the county with the national share: 'none' = inside the range chance alone gives a county of this size 95% of the time; '95' = outside it; '99.8' = outside the range chance gives 998 times in 1,000. Counties differ more than chance on most stages, so being outside the limits shows a real difference, not its cause.

artefact_flags.text_en: The median wait for surgery in the Northern Finland (OYS) area is 13.5 days, but the lower quartile is 0: for at least a quarter of operated patients the cancer was diagnosed at the operation itself. The short median reflects how the diagnosis date is set, not fast care.
artefact_flags.text_fi: Leikkaukseen pääsyn mediaani yhteistyöalueella on 13,5 päivää, mutta alakvartiili on 0: vähintään joka neljännellä leikatulla syöpä todettiin vasta leikkauksessa. Lyhyt mediaani kertoo diagnoosipäivän määrittelystä, ei nopeasta hoidosta.

artefact_flags.text_en: The MDT share counts two procedure codes that most hospitals do not record (6% nationally). It measures coding, not whether cases are discussed.
artefact_flags.text_fi: MDT-osuus perustuu kahteen toimenpidekoodiin, joita useimmat sairaalat eivät kirjaa (koko maassa 6 %). Luku kuvaa kirjaamista, ei sitä, käsitelläänkö potilaat kokouksessa.

main_leak.sentence_en: Of 100 lung cancer patients in Kainuu, 8 are operated. In Finland it is 15. That is about 3 patients a year.
main_leak.sentence_fi: Kainuun hyvinvointialueella sadasta keuhkosyöpäpotilaasta 8 leikataan. Koko Suomessa luku on 15. Ero on noin 3 potilasta vuodessa.
main_leak.basis_en: The stage where this county is furthest on the worse side of the national share, measured in units of chance variation for a county of its size. Stages with a recording flag are left out. A measured difference, not its cause.

by_modality.note_en: 45 patients a year x (national operated share 15% - this county's 7.5%), capped at the total. Operated shares are the registry's age-standardised 6-month figures for 2018-mid 2022 (mean of men and women), a different period than the total.

The rest: total minus the surgery part. Nationally the curative treatments other than surgery are stereotactic radiotherapy (11.2% of patients) and chemoradiotherapy (0.9%); neither is published by county, so this part is by subtraction, not measured.

missing_patients.split_method_en: Surgery part from the county's operated share against the national one; the remainder is assigned to curative radiotherapy by subtraction.
missing_patients.note_en: 45 new patients a year x (27% nationally - 20.8% here) = 2.8 patients a year (0.1-5.1 from the exact 95% interval of the county's share). Against the share reached by the best quarter of counties (30.4%) it is 4.3 a year. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness, and the registry cannot say which of these patients could have been treated to cure.

headroom.note_en: Patients a year between this county's curative share and the share of the best quarter of counties.

expected.method_en: Expected share = what a county with this share of residents aged 65 or over would have if it followed the pattern of the other 21 counties (quasi-binomial regression of curative-intent counts on the county's 65+ share, fitted without the county itself). Ratio = observed / expected; the interval allows for counties varying 4.1 times more than chance alone. This is an ecological adjustment: it uses the age of the county's residents, not of its patients, because the registry publishes neither the national share by age nor the age of each county's patients. It can remove an age-structure difference between counties; it cannot show why a county differs.
adjusted_for: share of county residents aged 65 or over (Statistics Finland, county level)
not_adjusted_for: stage at diagnosis (unknown for 48% of patients nationally, so it cannot be used)
how the cancer was found (symptoms, incidental, emergency)
treatment given outside the county's own records
expected.distance_en: Distance to the university hospital is reported, not adjusted away, because distance is part of access to treatment. Across counties the curative share falls with distance (Spearman rho -0.66, permutation p 0.000); after the 65+ adjustment the link is rho -0.30 (p 0.18). Distance and age structure go together in Finland, so 22 counties cannot separate them.
expected.why_not_standardised_en: Indirect standardisation by age and stage was not possible: the registry's public report gives the curative share for all patients only, not by age group or stage, and stage is unknown for 48% of patients.

registry_age_standardised_surgery.note_en: The registry's own adjustment, for surgery only: operated share standardised to the age of all Finnish patients (four age groups), by sex, with its 95% confidence interval. Where the interval lies below the national share, age does not explain the county's lower operated share.

expected.sentence_en: Observed 20.8%, expected 21.5% for a county with 31.8% of residents aged 65+: ratio 0.97 (0.57-1.65). Within the range the county's age structure predicts.

20.clock_note_en: Secondary view. The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: steps 1-4 are national figures scaled by public county indicators with assumed effect sizes; only diagnosis to treatment is measured, per collaborative area. Days saved is not a headline number.

mortality_vs_incidence.sentence_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in Kainuu is 1.12 times the national rate (39.94 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 0.98 times (46.25 vs 46.98). Mortality is further above the national rate than incidence is.

steps.label_en: First symptom to first primary care contact
steps.method_en: National median for this step (56.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 6 of 6 indicators available for this county (forgone_care_due_to_money_pct, daily_smokers_pct, low_income_rate_pct, education_level_index, crc_screening_participation_pct, sparse_rural_pop_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Had to cut back on food, medicines or doctor visits for lack of money
drivers.rationale_en: People who skip care for cost reasons present later.

drivers.label_en: Daily smokers, adults
drivers.rationale_en: Smokers tend to normalise a cough and wait longer before seeking help.

drivers.label_en: At-risk-of-poverty rate
drivers.rationale_en: Lower income is associated with later presentation.

drivers.label_en: Measure of educational level
drivers.rationale_en: Lower education carries higher odds of stage IV at diagnosis (Finnish registry study).

drivers.label_en: Colorectal cancer screening participation
drivers.rationale_en: Proxy for how readily residents take up health services.

drivers.label_en: Share living in sparsely populated rural areas
drivers.rationale_en: Long distances to the health centre raise the threshold to seek care.

steps.label_en: First primary care contact to referral
steps.method_en: National median for this step (41.0 days; reported) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 4 of 4 indicators available for this county (primary_care_wait_over_7d_pct, primary_care_wait_over_3m_pct, nurse_wait_over_7d_pct, continuity_of_care_coci). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent GP visits with a wait over 7 days from assessment of need
drivers.rationale_en: Each GP visit in the work-up waits in the same queue.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent GP visits with a wait over 3 months
drivers.rationale_en: Very long GP waits mark the worst-served areas.

drivers.label_en: Non-urgent nurse visits with a wait over 7 days
drivers.rationale_en: Nurse triage is often the first contact.

drivers.label_en: Continuity of care (COCI) in primary care physician visits
drivers.rationale_en: Seeing the same doctor makes a persisting symptom easier to recognise.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (9.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 2 of 3 indicators available for this county (pulmonology_referrals_handled_over_21d_pct, specialist_wait_over_6m_per_10k). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Referrals processed in more than 21 days (pulmonary diseases)
drivers.rationale_en: Slow referral processing delays every booking.

drivers.label_en: Waited over 6 months for specialist care, per 10,000 inhabitants
drivers.rationale_en: General congestion of specialist care in the area.

queue.method_en: Standing queue: service rate equals arrivals (backlog neither grows nor shrinks) and backlog / service rate reproduces the estimated wait. Only added capacity shortens it.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (12.1 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 3 of 3 indicators available for this county (pulmonology_queue_over_90d_pct, km_to_university_hospital, lung_mdt_recorded_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Waiting for treatment over 90 days (pulmonary diseases)
drivers.rationale_en: Pulmonology procedure queue (bronchoscopy etc., all diagnoses).

drivers.label_en: Distance to nearest university hospital (population-weighted, approx. road km)
drivers.note: method: population-weighted municipal centroid great-circle distance x 1.3; nearest for most residents: OYS; inputs: OSM Nominatim hospital coordinates, Statistics Finland municipal boundaries 2026 and population 2025
drivers.rationale_en: PET-CT, EBUS and MDT are centralised; distance adds scheduling time.

drivers.label_en: Lung cancer patients with a recorded multidisciplinary team (MDT) meeting
drivers.rationale_en: A recorded MDT decision is a marker of an organised diagnostic process.

queue.method_en: Standing queue: service rate equals arrivals (backlog neither grows nor shrinks) and backlog / service rate reproduces the estimated wait. Only added capacity shortens it.

steps.method_en: Measured for the collaborative area, not the county: Finnish Cancer Registry median days from diagnosis to first treatment in the Northern Finland (OYS) collaborative area, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022 (patients treated within 6 months): surgery 13.5, radiotherapy 31, drug therapy 42. Combined with the county treatment mix (surgery 7.5%, radiotherapy 30.1%, drug therapy 16.6% of patients) = 31.9 days. The medians are measured for the collaborative area, not the county; the weighting is arithmetic. No interval is published per area.

data_gaps.what_en: Days from referral to first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer, by county
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The largest controllable wait; today only all-diagnosis queue shares are public.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Wellbeing services counties / THL (Hilmo already holds referral and visit dates)

data_gaps.what_en: Days from first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and diagnosis to treatment start by county (today: five collaborative areas only)
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Without it the model has to estimate where time is lost before diagnosis; the registry already publishes diagnosis to treatment per collaborative area.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: University and central hospitals; the national cancer centre (FICAN) quality registers

data_gaps.what_en: Stage, age and performance status of each county's patients (stage is unknown for 48% nationally), and the curative share by stage
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Would separate a gap in care from a difference in who gets ill. Today the adjustment can only use the age of the county's residents.

data_gaps.what_en: Stereotactic radiotherapy and chemoradiotherapy by county, and the reason when no treatment is on record
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The care path can split the missing curative patients into surgery and 'the rest' only by subtraction, and cannot tell an untreated patient from an unrecorded treatment.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Finnish Cancer Registry; the counties' own records

data_gaps.what_en: Date of first symptom or first primary care contact for cancer patients
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The patient and primary care intervals are the longest part of the pathway and are not recorded anywhere nationally.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Primary care records (Avohilmo) linked to the Cancer Registry by THL / Findata

consistency_check.what_en: Spearman rank correlation, across counties, between the estimated days from first symptom to diagnosis (steps 1-4) and three measured outcomes.

results.sentence_en: Expected direction: counties with a longer estimated wait have lower share treated with curative intent, moderately (rho -0.30, n 22, permutation p 0.17; could be chance).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in one-year survival (rho -0.04, n 22).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in age-standardised lung cancer mortality (rho +0.10, n 23).

consistency_check.summary_en: 0 of 3 outcomes correlate with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance. This is a check, not a validation: it is county-level, with about 22 points, and confounded by age, smoking and stage at diagnosis. The priors were not tuned to improve it.
consistency_check.caveat_en: A check, not a validation; county-level, confounded by age, smoking and stage.

20.total_method_en: National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.
