meta.interval: clock (days): 80% (10th-90th percentile) of the estimate. Measures (patients, deaths): Range, not a probability interval: lowest and highest value when every effect size and conversion assumption is moved together from its lower bound to its upper bound. The point estimate uses the published or central values.
meta.care_path_interval: exact binomial 95% interval from the county's own counts; funnel limits 95% and 99.8% around the national share

inputs.parameters: real (12 fields mapped: steps.patient, steps.primary, steps.referral, steps.diagnosis, steps.treatment, benchmarks, specialist_floor, hazard_per_4w, curative_share, survival_5y.early, survival_5y.late, measured_hospital_times(0 usable))

notes: measured_hospital_times: Tyks (Turku University Hospital) has no value the evidence agent could open (left empty rather than filled from memory): its steps stay estimated

National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.
meta.incidence_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
meta.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
meta.benchmark_floor_en: Patient and primary care steps: not below 43% of the national median (best Nordic total 67 days / Finnish 155 days). Referral, diagnosis and treatment steps: not below 72% of the national median (best Nordic standard time referral to treatment 42 days, NO_pakkeforlop_lung, / Finnish 58 days).

area.patients_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
area.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
area.curative_gap_note_en: 142 new patients a year x (30.4% - 18.5%) = 16.8 patients a year. 30.4% is the share reached by the best quarter of counties (2019-2023); patients = new lung cancers 2019-2023 / 5. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness.

stages.quote: Kuva 13: Keuhkosyöpäpotilaiden levinneisyysluokitus hyvinvointialueittain | Ei tietoa | Osuus potilaista (%)
stages.note_en: 100 minus the share with no stage information. A recording measure: it says how complete the registry's stage data is, not how well patients were staged. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about two percentage points, so no interval is given.

stages.quote: Lapin hyvinvointialue | 21 | 710 | 3.0
stages.note_en: A recording measure, not a measure of care: MDT meetings are picked from the hospital discharge register by two procedure codes (WZC15, WZC20), which most hospitals do not record. A low share says the meeting is not coded, not that it did not happen.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Lapin hyvinvointialue | 131 | 710 | 18.5
stages.note_en: Patients with surgery, stereotactic radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy within 12 months of diagnosis, of all patients diagnosed 2019-2023. Not adjusted for age, stage or other illness.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Leikkaushoito | Lapin | 9,1 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Leikkaushoito | Lapin | 10,4
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are from the registry's own 95% confidence intervals for men and women (normal approximation).
stages.registry_ci_read_by: claude (read from the PDF page images on 2026-11-13; percentages agree with the rows Gemini read from the same table)

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Sädehoito | Lapin | 21,5 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Sädehoito | Lapin | 22,0
stages.note_en: Any radiotherapy, curative or palliative. Curative (stereotactic) radiotherapy is published for the whole country only (11.2% of patients 2019-2023), not by county. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Lääkehoito | Lapin | 10,0 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Lääkehoito | Lapin | 10,6
stages.note_en: Drug treatment is under-recorded in the national registers: only treatment given at a hospital contact is captured. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: Lapin hyvinvointialue | 114 | 710 | 16.1
stages.note_en: Drug therapy or radiotherapy that slows the cancer. Treatment groups overlap: one patient can be in several.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Lapin hyvinvointialue | 316 | 710 | 44.5
stages.note_en: Palliative care recorded. Treatment groups overlap.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Lapin hyvinvointialue | 240 | 710 | 33.8
stages.note_en: No treatment of any kind found in the registers within 12 months. This mixes patients who were not treated with patients whose treatment was not recorded; public data cannot tell them apart.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.label_en: Days from diagnosis to first treatment
stages.quote: TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Leikkaushoito | Mediaani 13,5 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Sädehoito | Mediaani 31,0 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Pohjois-Suomi | Lääkehoito | Mediaani 42,0
stages.note_en: Not a county value. The registry publishes median days by collaborative area and treatment type only; this is the Northern Finland (OYS) area's three medians (surgery 13.5, radiotherapy 31, drug therapy 42) weighted by the national treatment mix, so every county in the area shows the same number. Only patients treated within 6 months are counted. No interval is published; rank is among the five collaborative areas (1 = longest).

stages.quote: Kuva 20: Ikäkorjattu elossaolo-osuus sukupuolittain ja hyvinvointialueittain; Lapin hva, Mies, Kuukausia seurannan alusta 12
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share alive 12 months after diagnosis; published by sex, the value is the mean of men and women. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about one percentage point, so no interval or limits are given. Survival follows stage at diagnosis and age as well as treatment.

care_path.rank_note_en: Rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side (for context stages: the lowest value).
care_path.limits_note_en: outside_limits compares the county with the national share: 'none' = inside the range chance alone gives a county of this size 95% of the time; '95' = outside it; '99.8' = outside the range chance gives 998 times in 1,000. Counties differ more than chance on most stages, so being outside the limits shows a real difference, not its cause.

artefact_flags.text_en: 33.8% of patients have no treatment on record (Finland 27.5%) while only 16.1% have life-prolonging treatment on record (Finland 30.4%). Part of this is likely treatment that was given but not recorded; public data cannot say how much. The curative share may be understated for the same reason. Audit the records before reading it as a gap in care.
artefact_flags.text_fi: 33,8 %:lla potilaista ei ole hoitotietoa (koko maa 27,5 %), ja jarruttavaa hoitoa on kirjattu vain 16,1 %:lle (koko maa 30,4 %). Osa tästä on todennäköisesti kirjaamatta jäänyttä hoitoa; julkisesta aineistosta ei näe, kuinka suuri osa. Myös parantavan hoidon osuus voi samasta syystä näyttää liian pieneltä. Kirjaukset kannattaa tarkistaa ennen johtopäätöksiä.

artefact_flags.text_en: The median wait for surgery in the Northern Finland (OYS) area is 13.5 days, but the lower quartile is 0: for at least a quarter of operated patients the cancer was diagnosed at the operation itself. The short median reflects how the diagnosis date is set, not fast care.
artefact_flags.text_fi: Leikkaukseen pääsyn mediaani yhteistyöalueella on 13,5 päivää, mutta alakvartiili on 0: vähintään joka neljännellä leikatulla syöpä todettiin vasta leikkauksessa. Lyhyt mediaani kertoo diagnoosipäivän määrittelystä, ei nopeasta hoidosta.

artefact_flags.text_en: The MDT share counts two procedure codes that most hospitals do not record (6% nationally). It measures coding, not whether cases are discussed.
artefact_flags.text_fi: MDT-osuus perustuu kahteen toimenpidekoodiin, joita useimmat sairaalat eivät kirjaa (koko maassa 6 %). Luku kuvaa kirjaamista, ei sitä, käsitelläänkö potilaat kokouksessa.

main_leak.sentence_en: Of 100 lung cancer patients in Lapland, 18 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 12 patients a year.
main_leak.sentence_fi: Lapin hyvinvointialueella sadasta keuhkosyöpäpotilaasta 18 saa parantavaan pyrkivää hoitoa. Koko Suomessa luku on 27. Ero on noin 12 potilasta vuodessa.
main_leak.basis_en: The stage where this county is furthest on the worse side of the national share, measured in units of chance variation for a county of its size. Stages with a recording flag are left out. A measured difference, not its cause.

by_modality.note_en: 142 patients a year x (national operated share 15% - this county's 9.8%), capped at the total. Operated shares are the registry's age-standardised 6-month figures for 2018-mid 2022 (mean of men and women), a different period than the total.

The rest: total minus the surgery part. Nationally the curative treatments other than surgery are stereotactic radiotherapy (11.2% of patients) and chemoradiotherapy (0.9%); neither is published by county, so this part is by subtraction, not measured.

missing_patients.split_method_en: Surgery part from the county's operated share against the national one; the remainder is assigned to curative radiotherapy by subtraction.
missing_patients.note_en: 142 new patients a year x (27% nationally - 18.5% here) = 12.1 patients a year (7.8-16 from the exact 95% interval of the county's share). Against the share reached by the best quarter of counties (30.4%) it is 16.8 a year. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness, and the registry cannot say which of these patients could have been treated to cure. This county carries a recording flag: part of the shortfall may be treatment that was given but not recorded.

headroom.note_en: Patients a year between this county's curative share and the share of the best quarter of counties.

expected.method_en: Expected share = what a county with this share of residents aged 65 or over would have if it followed the pattern of the other 21 counties (quasi-binomial regression of curative-intent counts on the county's 65+ share, fitted without the county itself). Ratio = observed / expected; the interval allows for counties varying 4.1 times more than chance alone. This is an ecological adjustment: it uses the age of the county's residents, not of its patients, because the registry publishes neither the national share by age nor the age of each county's patients. It can remove an age-structure difference between counties; it cannot show why a county differs.
adjusted_for: share of county residents aged 65 or over (Statistics Finland, county level)
not_adjusted_for: stage at diagnosis (unknown for 48% of patients nationally, so it cannot be used)
how the cancer was found (symptoms, incidental, emergency)
treatment given outside the county's own records
expected.distance_en: Distance to the university hospital is reported, not adjusted away, because distance is part of access to treatment. Across counties the curative share falls with distance (Spearman rho -0.66, permutation p 0.000); after the 65+ adjustment the link is rho -0.30 (p 0.18). Distance and age structure go together in Finland, so 22 counties cannot separate them.
expected.why_not_standardised_en: Indirect standardisation by age and stage was not possible: the registry's public report gives the curative share for all patients only, not by age group or stage, and stage is unknown for 48% of patients.

registry_age_standardised_surgery.note_en: The registry's own adjustment, for surgery only: operated share standardised to the age of all Finnish patients (four age groups), by sex, with its 95% confidence interval. Where the interval lies below the national share, age does not explain the county's lower operated share.

expected.sentence_en: Observed 18.5%, expected 24.6% for a county with 28.1% of residents aged 65+: ratio 0.75 (0.58-0.97). Below what the county's age structure predicts.

21.clock_note_en: Secondary view. The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: steps 1-4 are national figures scaled by public county indicators with assumed effect sizes; only diagnosis to treatment is measured, per collaborative area. Days saved is not a headline number.

mortality_vs_incidence.sentence_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in Lapland is 1.31 times the national rate (46.79 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 1.24 times (58.26 vs 46.98). Most of the mortality difference is already there in how many people get lung cancer; it does not by itself show worse results after diagnosis.

steps.label_en: First symptom to first primary care contact
steps.method_en: National median for this step (56.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 6 of 6 indicators available for this county (forgone_care_due_to_money_pct, daily_smokers_pct, low_income_rate_pct, education_level_index, crc_screening_participation_pct, sparse_rural_pop_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

steps.method_en: Measured for the collaborative area, not the county: Finnish Cancer Registry median days from diagnosis to first treatment in the Northern Finland (OYS) collaborative area, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022 (patients treated within 6 months): surgery 13.5, radiotherapy 31, drug therapy 42. data_gaps.what_en: Days from referral to first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer, by county
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The largest controllable wait; today only all-diagnosis queue shares are public.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Wellbeing services counties / THL (Hilmo already holds referral and visit dates)

data_gaps.what_en: Days from first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and diagnosis to treatment start by county (today: five collaborative areas only)
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Without it the model has to estimate where time is lost before diagnosis; the registry already publishes diagnosis to treatment per collaborative area.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: University and central hospitals; the national cancer centre (FICAN) quality registers

data_gaps.what_en: Stage, age and performance status of each county's patients (stage is unknown for 48% nationally), and the curative share by stage
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Would separate a gap in care from a difference in who gets ill. Today the adjustment can only use the age of the county's residents.

data_gaps.what_en: Stereotactic radiotherapy and chemoradiotherapy by county, and the reason when no treatment is on record
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The care path can split the missing curative patients into surgery and 'the rest' only by subtraction, and cannot tell an untreated patient from an unrecorded treatment.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Finnish Cancer Registry; the counties' own records

data_gaps.what_en: Date of first symptom or first primary care contact for cancer patients
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The patient and primary care intervals are the longest part of the pathway and are not recorded anywhere nationally.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Primary care records (Avohilmo) linked to the Cancer Registry by THL / Findata

measured_gaps.label_en: Lung cancer deaths per 100,000 person-years, age-standardised (Finnish Cancer Registry)
measured_gaps.note_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in Lapland is 1.31 times the national rate (46.79 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 1.24 times (58.26 vs 46.98). Most of the mortality difference is already there in how many people get lung cancer; it does not by itself show worse results after diagnosis. 46.8 here, 35.8 nationally: worse than the national value (rank 1 of 23; rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side. Best county: North Savo, 28.2). Age-standardised to the Finnish 2014 population by the registry, so areas with older residents can be compared. A measured difference between areas, not an explanation of it.

measured_gaps.label_en: Lung cancer patients who got curative-intent treatment
measured_gaps.note_en: 18.5 here, 27 nationally: worse than the national value (rank 1 of 22; rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side. Best county: Vantaa and Kerava, 35.6). A measured difference between areas, not an explanation of it. Gap in patients: 142 new patients a year x (30.4% - 18.5%) = 16.8 patients a year. 30.4% is the share reached by the best quarter of counties (2019-2023); patients = new lung cancers 2019-2023 / 5. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness.

consistency_check.what_en: Spearman rank correlation, across counties, between the estimated days from first symptom to diagnosis (steps 1-4) and three measured outcomes.

results.sentence_en: Expected direction: counties with a longer estimated wait have lower share treated with curative intent, moderately (rho -0.30, n 22, permutation p 0.17; could be chance).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in one-year survival (rho -0.04, n 22).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in age-standardised lung cancer mortality (rho +0.10, n 23).

consistency_check.summary_en: 0 of 3 outcomes correlate with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance. This is a check, not a validation: it is county-level, with about 22 points, and confounded by age, smoking and stage at diagnosis. The priors were not tuned to improve it.
consistency_check.caveat_en: A check, not a validation; county-level, confounded by age, smoking and stage.

21.total_method_en: National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.

meta.interval: clock (days): 80% (10th-90th percentile) of the estimate. Measures (patients, deaths): Range, not a probability interval: lowest and highest value when every effect size and conversion assumption is moved together from its lower bound to its upper bound. The point estimate uses the published or central values.
meta.care_path_interval: exact binomial 95% interval from the county's own counts; funnel limits 95% and 99.8% around the national share

inputs.parameters: real (12 fields mapped: steps.patient, steps.primary, steps.referral, steps.diagnosis, steps.treatment, benchmarks, specialist_floor, hazard_per_4w, curative_share, survival_5y.early, survival_5y.late, measured_hospital_times(0 usable))

notes: measured_hospital_times: Tyks (Turku University Hospital) has no value the evidence agent could open (left empty rather than filled from memory): its steps stay estimated

National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.
meta.incidence_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
meta.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
meta.benchmark_floor_en: Patient and primary care steps: not below 43% of the national median (best Nordic total 67 days / Finnish 155 days). Referral, diagnosis and treatment steps: not below 72% of the national median (best Nordic standard time referral to treatment 42 days, NO_pakkeforlop_lung, / Finnish 58 days).

area.patients_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
area.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
area.curative_gap_note_en: 297 new patients a year x (30.4% - 33.0%) = 0.0 patients a year (floored at 0: the county is already at or above that share). 30.4% is the share reached by the best quarter of counties (2019-2023); patients = new lung cancers 2019-2023 / 5. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness.

stages.quote: Kuva 13: Keuhkosyöpäpotilaiden levinneisyysluokitus hyvinvointialueittain | Ei tietoa | Osuus potilaista (%)
stages.note_en: 100 minus the share with no stage information. A recording measure: it says how complete the registry's stage data is, not how well patients were staged. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about two percentage points, so no interval is given.

stages.quote: Helsingin kaupunki | 1 | 1486 | 0.1
stages.note_en: A recording measure, not a measure of care: MDT meetings are picked from the hospital discharge register by two procedure codes (WZC15, WZC20), which most hospitals do not record. A low share says the meeting is not coded, not that it did not happen.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Helsingin kaupunki | 491 | 1486 | 33.0
stages.note_en: Patients with surgery, stereotactic radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy within 12 months of diagnosis, of all patients diagnosed 2019-2023. Not adjusted for age, stage or other illness.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Leikkaushoito | Helsingin kaupunki | 13,4 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Leikkaushoito | Helsingin kaupunki | 18,6
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are from the registry's own 95% confidence intervals for men and women (normal approximation).
stages.registry_ci_read_by: claude (read from the PDF page images on 2026-11-13; percentages agree with the rows Gemini read from the same table)

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Sädehoito | Helsingin kaupunki | 28,7 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Sädehoito | Helsingin kaupunki | 27,3
stages.note_en: Any radiotherapy, curative or palliative. Curative (stereotactic) radiotherapy is published for the whole country only (11.2% of patients 2019-2023), not by county. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: TAULUKKO 3.7 | Miehet | Lääkehoito | Helsingin kaupunki | 26,1 ; TAULUKKO 3.7 | Naiset | Lääkehoito | Helsingin kaupunki | 22,9
stages.note_en: Drug treatment is under-recorded in the national registers: only treatment given at a hospital contact is captured. Age-standardised share within 6 months of diagnosis, 1.1.2018-30.6.2022; the registry publishes it for men and women separately and the value shown is the mean of the two (arithmetic on two measured values). A different period and follow-up than the 2019-2023 stages.
stages.interval_basis_en: Interval and limits are approximate: binomial with the county's 2019-2023 patient count scaled to 4.5 years, because the registry's interval for this row is not loaded (normal approximation).

stages.quote: Helsingin kaupunki | 457 | 1486 | 30.8
stages.note_en: Drug therapy or radiotherapy that slows the cancer. Treatment groups overlap: one patient can be in several.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Helsingin kaupunki | 513 | 1486 | 34.5
stages.note_en: Palliative care recorded. Treatment groups overlap.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.quote: Helsingin kaupunki | 432 | 1486 | 29.1
stages.note_en: No treatment of any kind found in the registers within 12 months. This mixes patients who were not treated with patients whose treatment was not recorded; public data cannot tell them apart.
stages.cross_check_en: Count and denominator were also parsed from the report's HTML table; the two readings agree.

stages.label_en: Days from diagnosis to first treatment
stages.quote: TAULUKKO 4.1 | Etelä-Suomi | Leikkaushoito | Mediaani 46,0 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Etelä-Suomi | Sädehoito | Mediaani 39,0 ; TAULUKKO 4.1 | Etelä-Suomi | Lääkehoito | Mediaani 36,0
stages.note_en: Not a county value. The registry publishes median days by collaborative area and treatment type only; this is the Southern Finland (HUS) area's three medians (surgery 46, radiotherapy 39, drug therapy 36) weighted by the national treatment mix, so every county in the area shows the same number. Only patients treated within 6 months are counted. No interval is published; rank is among the five collaborative areas (1 = longest).

stages.quote: Kuva 20: Ikäkorjattu elossaolo-osuus sukupuolittain ja hyvinvointialueittain; Helsingin kaupunki, Mies, Kuukausia seurannan alusta 12
stages.note_en: Age-standardised share alive 12 months after diagnosis; published by sex, the value is the mean of men and women. Read off a chart, not a table: accurate to about one percentage point, so no interval or limits are given. Survival follows stage at diagnosis and age as well as treatment.

care_path.rank_note_en: Rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side (for context stages: the lowest value).
care_path.limits_note_en: outside_limits compares the county with the national share: 'none' = inside the range chance alone gives a county of this size 95% of the time; '95' = outside it; '99.8' = outside the range chance gives 998 times in 1,000. Counties differ more than chance on most stages, so being outside the limits shows a real difference, not its cause.

artefact_flags.text_en: The MDT share counts two procedure codes that most hospitals do not record (6% nationally). It measures coding, not whether cases are discussed.
artefact_flags.text_fi: MDT-osuus perustuu kahteen toimenpidekoodiin, joita useimmat sairaalat eivät kirjaa (koko maassa 6 %). Luku kuvaa kirjaamista, ei sitä, käsitelläänkö potilaat kokouksessa.

main_leak.sentence_en: Of 100 lung cancer patients in Helsinki, 33 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. No stage of the care path is below the national level beyond chance.
main_leak.sentence_fi: Helsingin kaupunki: sadasta keuhkosyöpäpotilaasta 33 saa parantavaan pyrkivää hoitoa. Koko Suomessa luku on 27. Mikään hoitopolun vaihe ei jää koko maan tasosta satunnaisvaihtelua enempää.

missing_patients.split_method_en: No split: the county is not below the reference, or its operated share is not published.
missing_patients.note_en: 297 new patients a year x (27% nationally - 33% here) = 0 patients a year (0-0 from the exact 95% interval of the county's share; floored at 0). Against the share reached by the best quarter of counties (30.4%) it is 0 a year. Arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate: counties differ in age, stage at diagnosis and other illness, and the registry cannot say which of these patients could have been treated to cure.

headroom.note_en: Patients a year between this county's curative share and the share of the best quarter of counties.

expected.method_en: Expected share = what a county with this share of residents aged 65 or over would have if it followed the pattern of the other 21 counties (quasi-binomial regression of curative-intent counts on the county's 65+ share, fitted without the county itself). Ratio = observed / expected; the interval allows for counties varying 4.1 times more than chance alone. This is an ecological adjustment: it uses the age of the county's residents, not of its patients, because the registry publishes neither the national share by age nor the age of each county's patients. It can remove an age-structure difference between counties; it cannot show why a county differs.
adjusted_for: share of county residents aged 65 or over (Statistics Finland, county level)
not_adjusted_for: stage at diagnosis (unknown for 48% of patients nationally, so it cannot be used)
how the cancer was found (symptoms, incidental, emergency)
treatment given outside the county's own records
expected.distance_en: Distance to the university hospital is reported, not adjusted away, because distance is part of access to treatment. Across counties the curative share falls with distance (Spearman rho -0.66, permutation p 0.000); after the 65+ adjustment the link is rho -0.30 (p 0.18). Distance and age structure go together in Finland, so 22 counties cannot separate them.
expected.why_not_standardised_en: Indirect standardisation by age and stage was not possible: the registry's public report gives the curative share for all patients only, not by age group or stage, and stage is unknown for 48% of patients.

registry_age_standardised_surgery.note_en: The registry's own adjustment, for surgery only: operated share standardised to the age of all Finnish patients (four age groups), by sex, with its 95% confidence interval. Where the interval lies below the national share, age does not explain the county's lower operated share.

expected.sentence_en: Observed 33%, expected 32.7% for a county with 17.7% of residents aged 65+: ratio 1.01 (0.84-1.22). Within the range the county's age structure predicts.

90.clock_note_en: Secondary view. The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: steps 1-4 are national figures scaled by public county indicators with assumed effect sizes; only diagnosis to treatment is measured, per collaborative area. Days saved is not a headline number.

mortality_vs_incidence.sentence_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in Helsinki is 1.04 times the national rate (37.33 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 1.07 times (50.16 vs 46.98). Mortality is close to the national rate.

steps.label_en: First symptom to first primary care contact
steps.method_en: National median for this step (56.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 6 of 6 indicators available for this county (forgone_care_due_to_money_pct, daily_smokers_pct, low_income_rate_pct, education_level_index, crc_screening_participation_pct, sparse_rural_pop_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

steps.label_en: First primary care contact to referral
steps.method_en: National median for this step (41.0 days; reported) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 4 of 4 indicators available for this county (primary_care_wait_over_7d_pct, primary_care_wait_over_3m_pct, nurse_wait_over_7d_pct, continuity_of_care_coci). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Continuity of care (COCI) in primary care physician visits
drivers.rationale_en: Seeing the same doctor makes a persisting symptom easier to recognise.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (9.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 3 of 3 indicators available for this county (pulmonology_assessment_over_90d_pct, pulmonology_referrals_handled_over_21d_pct, specialist_wait_over_6m_per_10k). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Waited over 6 months for specialist care, per 10,000 inhabitants

queue.method_en: Standing queue: service rate equals arrivals (backlog neither grows nor shrinks) and backlog / service rate reproduces the estimated wait. Only added capacity shortens it.

data_gaps.what_en: Days from referral to first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer, by county
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The largest controllable wait; today only all-diagnosis queue shares are public.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Wellbeing services counties / THL (Hilmo already holds referral and visit dates)

data_gaps.what_en: Days from first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and diagnosis to treatment start by county (today: five collaborative areas only)
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Without it the model has to estimate where time is lost before diagnosis; the registry already publishes diagnosis to treatment per collaborative area.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: University and central hospitals; the national cancer centre (FICAN) quality registers

data_gaps.what_en: Stage, age and performance status of each county's patients (stage is unknown for 48% nationally), and the curative share by stage
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Would separate a gap in care from a difference in who gets ill. Today the adjustment can only use the age of the county's residents.

data_gaps.what_en: Stereotactic radiotherapy and chemoradiotherapy by county, and the reason when no treatment is on record
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The care path can split the missing curative patients into surgery and 'the rest' only by subtraction, and cannot tell an untreated patient from an unrecorded treatment.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Finnish Cancer Registry; the counties' own records

data_gaps.what_en: Date of first symptom or first primary care contact for cancer patients
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The patient and primary care intervals are the longest part of the pathway and are not recorded anywhere nationally.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Primary care records (Avohilmo) linked to the Cancer Registry by THL / Findata

data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Would narrow the estimate of the primary step.

lung_mortality_asr.note_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in Helsinki is 1.04 times the national rate (37.33 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 1.07 times (50.16 vs 46.98). Mortality is close to the national rate. Age-standardised to the Finnish 2014 population by the registry, so areas with older residents can be compared.

consistency_check.what_en: Spearman rank correlation, across counties, between the estimated days from first symptom to diagnosis (steps 1-4) and three measured outcomes.

results.sentence_en: Expected direction: counties with a longer estimated wait have lower share treated with curative intent, moderately (rho -0.30, n 22, permutation p 0.17; could be chance).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in one-year survival (rho -0.04, n 22).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in age-standardised lung cancer mortality (rho +0.10, n 23).

consistency_check.summary_en: 0 of 3 outcomes correlate with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance. This is a check, not a validation: it is county-level, with about 22 points, and confounded by age, smoking and stage at diagnosis. The priors were not tuned to improve it.
consistency_check.caveat_en: A check, not a validation; county-level, confounded by age, smoking and stage.

90.total_method_en: National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.

meta.interval: clock (days): 80% (10th-90th percentile) of the estimate. Measures (patients, deaths): Range, not a probability interval: lowest and highest value when every effect size and conversion assumption is moved together from its lower bound to its upper bound. The point estimate uses the published or central values.
meta.care_path_interval: exact binomial 95% interval from the county's own counts; funnel limits 95% and 99.8% around the national share

inputs.parameters: real (12 fields mapped: steps.patient, steps.primary, steps.referral, steps.diagnosis, steps.treatment, benchmarks, specialist_floor, hazard_per_4w, curative_share, survival_5y.early, survival_5y.late, measured_hospital_times(0 usable))

notes: measured_hospital_times: Tyks (Turku University Hospital) has no value the evidence agent could open (left empty rather than filled from memory): its steps stay estimated

National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.
meta.incidence_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
meta.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
meta.benchmark_floor_en: Patient and primary care steps: not below 43% of the national median (best Nordic total 67 days / Finnish 155 days). Referral, diagnosis and treatment steps: not below 72% of the national median (best Nordic standard time referral to treatment 42 days, NO_pakkeforlop_lung, / Finnish 58 days).

area.patients_basis: measured: new lung cancers per year, mean of 2019-2023 (lung_cases_5y_n / 5; an area missing there takes the registry statistics count for 2020-2024)
area.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
area.curative_gap_note_en: No county share of curative-intent treatment is published for this area.

care_path.rank_note_en: Rank 1 = the county furthest on the worse side (for context stages: the lowest value).
care_path.limits_note_en: outside_limits compares the county with the national share: 'none' = inside the range chance alone gives a county of this size 95% of the time; '95' = outside it; '99.8' = outside the range chance gives 998 times in 1,000. Counties differ more than chance on most stages, so being outside the limits shows a real difference, not its cause.
care_path.note_en: The registry does not publish care-path shares for this area: its patients are in the national totals but, with 93 patients in five years, not in the area tables.
care_path.note_quote: Ahvenanmaan alueen potilaat ovat mukana kokonaisluvuissa, mutta niitä ei esitetä aluekohtaisissa tuloksissa pienten lukumäärien takia (yhteensä 93 tapausta).

91.clock_note_en: Secondary view. The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: steps 1-4 are national figures scaled by public county indicators with assumed effect sizes; only diagnosis to treatment is measured, per collaborative area. Days saved is not a headline number.

mortality_vs_incidence.sentence_en: Age-standardised lung cancer mortality in Åland is 1.23 times the national rate (44.2 vs 35.79 per 100,000, 2020-2024); incidence is 1.04 times (48.83 vs 46.98). Mortality is further above the national rate than incidence is. Small numbers: 80 deaths in five years, so the rate is uncertain.

steps.label_en: First symptom to first primary care contact
steps.method_en: National median for this step (56.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 5 of 6 indicators available for this county (forgone_care_due_to_money_pct, daily_smokers_pct, low_income_rate_pct, education_level_index, sparse_rural_pop_pct). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (41.0 days; reported) multiplied by a county factor. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 1 of 4 indicators available for this county (continuity_of_care_coci). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

drivers.label_en: Continuity of care (COCI) in primary care physician visits
drivers.rationale_en: Seeing the same doctor makes a persisting symptom easier to recognise.

steps.method_en: National median for this step (9.0 days; estimated) multiplied by a county factor. The national figure is a residual (reported specialist interval minus the measured diagnosis-to-treatment time), not a measurement. The factor is exp(sum of elasticity x standardised indicator) over 0 of 3 indicators available for this county (none). The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

queue.method_en: Standing queue: service rate equals arrivals (backlog neither grows nor shrinks) and backlog / service rate reproduces the estimated wait. Only added capacity shortens it.

The elasticities are assumed priors, not fitted: Finland publishes no county-level step durations to fit against. Missing indicators are drawn at random. Factor kept within 0.6-1.8 and rescaled so counties average to the national figure. 80% interval from 2000 Monte Carlo draws.

consistency_check.what_en: Spearman rank correlation, across counties, between the estimated days from first symptom to diagnosis (steps 1-4) and three measured outcomes.

results.sentence_en: Expected direction: counties with a longer estimated wait have lower share treated with curative intent, moderately (rho -0.30, n 22, permutation p 0.17; could be chance).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in one-year survival (rho -0.04, n 22).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in age-standardised lung cancer mortality (rho +0.10, n 23).

consistency_check.summary_en: 0 of 3 outcomes correlate with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance. This is a check, not a validation: it is county-level, with about 22 points, and confounded by age, smoking and stage at diagnosis. The priors were not tuned to improve it.
consistency_check.caveat_en: A check, not a validation; county-level, confounded by age, smoking and stage.

91.total_method_en: National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.

expected.method_en: Expected share = what a county with this share of residents aged 65 or over would have if it followed the pattern of the other 21 counties (quasi-binomial regression of curative-intent counts on the county's 65+ share, fitted without the county itself). Ratio = observed / expected; the interval allows for counties varying 4.1 times more than chance alone. This is an ecological adjustment: it uses the age of the county's residents, not of its patients, because the registry publishes neither the national share by age nor the age of each county's patients. It can remove an age-structure difference between counties; it cannot show why a county differs.
adjusted_for: share of county residents aged 65 or over (Statistics Finland, county level)
not_adjusted_for: stage at diagnosis (unknown for 48% of patients nationally, so it cannot be used)
how the cancer was found (symptoms, incidental, emergency)
treatment given outside the county's own records
expected.distance_en: Distance to the university hospital is reported, not adjusted away, because distance is part of access to treatment. Across counties the curative share falls with distance (Spearman rho -0.66, permutation p 0.000); after the 65+ adjustment the link is rho -0.30 (p 0.18). Distance and age structure go together in Finland, so 22 counties cannot separate them.
expected.why_not_standardised_en: Indirect standardisation by age and stage was not possible: the registry's public report gives the curative share for all patients only, not by age group or stage, and stage is unknown for 48% of patients.

main_leak.sentence_en: Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance.
main_leak.sentence_fi: Suomessa sadasta keuhkosyöpäpotilaasta 27 saa parantavaan pyrkivää hoitoa. Alueittain luku vaihtelee 18:stä 36:een. Jos jokainen maan keskiarvon alle jäävä alue nousisi keskiarvoon, se tarkoittaisi noin 66 potilasta vuodessa. Heistä 50 on niillä 7 alueella, jotka jäävät keskiarvosta satunnaisvaihtelua enemmän.

missing_patients.note_en: Sum over counties of patients a year x (national share - county share), counties above the national share counted as 0: 66 a year. Against the best quarter of counties (30.4%): 123 a year. 7 of 22 counties are below the national share beyond chance; they account for 50 of the 66. Arithmetic, not a causal estimate.

FI.clock_note_en: Secondary view. The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: steps 1-4 are national figures scaled by public county indicators with assumed effect sizes; only diagnosis to treatment is measured, per collaborative area. Days saved is not a headline number.

consistency_check.what_en: Spearman rank correlation, across counties, between the estimated days from first symptom to diagnosis (steps 1-4) and three measured outcomes.

results.sentence_en: Expected direction: counties with a longer estimated wait have lower share treated with curative intent, moderately (rho -0.30, n 22, permutation p 0.17; could be chance).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in one-year survival (rho -0.04, n 22).
No relationship: counties with a longer estimated wait do not differ in age-standardised lung cancer mortality (rho +0.10, n 23).

consistency_check.summary_en: 0 of 3 outcomes correlate with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance. This is a check, not a validation: it is county-level, with about 22 points, and confounded by age, smoking and stage at diagnosis. The priors were not tuned to improve it.
consistency_check.caveat_en: A check, not a validation; county-level, confounded by age, smoking and stage.

FI.total_method_en: National total kept at the reported 155 days (unpublished four-city study reported by Yle, 2026; sample size not stated). Step 5 is the registry's measured 36.9 days; steps 3 and 4 share the residual 58 - 36.9 = 21 days.

data_gaps.what_en: Days from referral to first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer, by county
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The largest controllable wait; today only all-diagnosis queue shares are public.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Wellbeing services counties / THL (Hilmo already holds referral and visit dates)

data_gaps.what_en: Days from first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and diagnosis to treatment start by county (today: five collaborative areas only)
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Without it the model has to estimate where time is lost before diagnosis; the registry already publishes diagnosis to treatment per collaborative area.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: University and central hospitals; the national cancer centre (FICAN) quality registers

data_gaps.what_en: Stage, age and performance status of each county's patients (stage is unknown for 48% nationally), and the curative share by stage
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: Would separate a gap in care from a difference in who gets ill. Today the adjustment can only use the age of the county's residents.

data_gaps.what_en: Stereotactic radiotherapy and chemoradiotherapy by county, and the reason when no treatment is on record
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The care path can split the missing curative patients into surgery and 'the rest' only by subtraction, and cannot tell an untreated patient from an unrecorded treatment.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Finnish Cancer Registry; the counties' own records

data_gaps.what_en: Date of first symptom or first primary care contact for cancer patients
data_gaps.why_it_matters_en: The patient and primary care intervals are the longest part of the pathway and are not recorded anywhere nationally.
data_gaps.who_could_publish_en: Primary care records (Avohilmo) linked to the Cancer Registry by THL / Findata

meta.interval: clock (days): 80% (10th-90th percentile) of the estimate. Measures (patients, deaths): Range, not a probability interval: lowest and highest value when every effect size and conversion assumption is moved together from its lower bound to its upper bound. The point estimate uses the published or central values.
meta.care_path_interval: exact binomial 95% interval from the county's own counts; funnel limits 95% and 99.8% around the national share

meta.deaths_basis: measured: lung cancer deaths per year, Finnish Cancer Registry statistics, 2020-2024, five-year count / 5 (goal3.json)
meta.benchmark_floor_en: Patient and primary care steps: not below 43% of the national median (best Nordic total 67 days / Finnish 155 days). Referral, diagnosis and treatment steps: not below 72% of the national median (best Nordic standard time referral to treatment 42 days, NO_pakkeforlop_lung, / Finnish 58 days).

deaths_avoided_per_year.note_en: The lower bound is below zero and is shown as it is: the lung-specific estimate of how delay affects mortality is not statistically significant (Hanna et al., BMJ 2020: hazard ratio 1.06 per 4 weeks of delay to lung surgery, 95% CI 0.93-1.19), so 'no benefit' cannot be ruled out for deaths avoided through days saved.

cpp_pathway.note_en: Alone: 13.4 days saved per patient (central estimate) for 54 patients a year, of whom 28% are treated with curative intent. Each 28 days sooner divides their mortality hazard by 1.06 (Hanna, BMJ 2020; its interval includes no effect) = 0.15 deaths avoided a year.

ai_cxr_triage_alone.note_en: Alone: 0 days. It flags patients sooner but adds no capacity, so they wait in the same queue (LungIMPACT 2026 found the same). Pair it with capacity (ebus_capacity, same_day_cxr_ct).

reflex_molecular.note_en: Alone: 2.3 days saved per patient (central estimate) for 54 patients a year, of whom 28% are treated with curative intent; it reaches about 30% of those (non-small cell lung cancer whose first treatment waits for the biomarker result: advanced disease, and stage II-III patients whose perioperative or post-chemoradiotherapy drug depends on EGFR, ALK or PD-L1; assumption). Earlier start of life-prolonging drug treatment is a real benefit the model does not count.

ldct_screening.note_en: 996 people screened a year (1000 per 100,000 residents: the same people the cost pays for) x 3.3 lung cancer deaths per 1,000 of them a year without screening (NELSON control arm) x (1 - 0.84) = 0.53 deaths avoided a year, once the programme has run for several years. On its own it adds 0.0 (0.0-0.0). Deaths avoided: 0.0 x 0.15 deaths within five years per extra patient treated to cure (assumption, range 0.05-0.3; not a causal estimate) = 0.00 a year.

travel_accommodation_support.note_en: Alone: 1 percentage point x 54 patients a year x 0.09 (64 km to the university hospital (scaled 0 at 50 km, full at 200 km)) = 0.0 extra patients a year treated to cure (bounds 0-2 points; an assumption, see the evidence). Deaths avoided: 13.3 x 0.15 deaths within five years per extra patient treated to cure (assumption, range 0.05-0.3; not a causal estimate) = 2.00 a year.

prehab_fitness_assessment.note_en: Alone it would add 9.2 patients a year treated to cure across the counties where it applies. On its own it adds 9.2 (0.0-26.1). Deaths avoided: 9.2 x 0.15 deaths within five years per extra patient treated to cure (assumption, range 0.05-0.3; not a causal estimate) = 1.38 a year.

travel_accommodation_support.note_en: Alone it would add 8.6 patients a year treated to cure across the counties where it applies. On its own it adds 8.6 (0.0-16.1). Deaths avoided: 8.6 x 0.15 deaths within five years per extra patient treated to cure (assumption, range 0.05-0.3; not a causal estimate) = 1.29 a year.

recording_audit.note_en: Adds no treated patients and avoids no deaths; the model counts zero. It is bought first where 'no treatment on record' or recorded drug treatment looks like a recording gap, because until the records are checked the county cannot tell a care gap from a coding gap.

smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis.note_en: 2303 lung cancer deaths a year x 1.3% among the patients it reaches (assumption: deaths among curative-intent patients (about 15% of deaths) x 35% still smoking x 25% who quit because of the programme) x (1 - 0.67) = 9.88 deaths avoided a year. It does not shorten the pathway.

interventions.name_en: Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots
interventions.name_fi: Keuhkosyövän standardoitu hoitopolku ja varatut tutkimusajat
interventions.what_en: A lung cancer pathway on the Danish/Swedish/Norwegian model: fixed referral criteria, pre-booked CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots, a named pathway owner, and published time limits for each step.
interventions.what_fi: Tanskan, Ruotsin ja Norjan mallin mukainen hoitopolku: yhtenäiset lähetekriteerit, etukäteen varatut TT-, PET-TT-, bronkoskopia- ja MDT-ajat, nimetty vastuuhenkilö ja julkiset tavoiteajat joka vaiheelle.

cost.basis: Setup: process design and booking templates, 50 000 EUR. Yearly: 1.0 pathway coordinator nurse (60 000) + 0.2 pulmonologist as pathway owner (0.2 x 150 000 = 30 000). Booked slots reallocate existing capacity. National guideline and pathway work is budgeted separately in the roadmap: 5 000 000 EUR/year (measure 3.1.1, covers 2.5.2, 3.1.2-3.1.4).

interventions.prerequisite_en: Imaging and bronchoscopy slots must actually exist; needs time stamps recorded per step so the limits can be monitored.
interventions.owner_en: Chief physician of pulmonology (county pathway); FICAN and the national lung cancer group (national pathway description)
interventions.owner_fi: Keuhkosairauksien ylilääkäri (alueellinen polku); FICAN ja kansallinen keuhkosyöpäryhmä (kansallinen hoitoketjukuvaus)
interventions.first_step_en: Name one pathway owner and book fixed weekly CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots for suspected lung cancer.
interventions.first_step_fi: Nimetään hoitopolulle vastuuhenkilö ja varataan keuhkosyöpäepäilyille kiinteät viikoittaiset TT-, PET-TT-, bronkoskopia- ja MDT-ajat.

kpi.label_en: Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median)
kpi.target_rule_en: at or below the national median; published for the collaborative area, so the county must start reporting its own

interventions.name_en: Same-day chest X-ray report with immediate CT
interventions.name_fi: Thorax-kuvan lausunto samana päivänä ja välitön TT
interventions.what_en: A radiologist or reporting radiographer reads primary-care chest X-rays while the patient waits; if suspicious, CT is done the same day or within days and the referral is triggered by radiology.
interventions.what_fi: Radiologi lausuu perusterveydenhuollon thorax-kuvan potilaan odottaessa; epäilyttävä löydös johtaa TT-kuvaukseen samana päivänä tai lähipäivinä ja lähete käynnistyy radiologiasta.

cost.basis: Setup: workflow and referral-rule change, 20 000 EUR. Yearly: 0.5 radiologist for hot reporting (0.5 x 150 000 = 75 000) + 0.5 radiographer/coordinator (30 000). CT volume is brought forward, not added.

interventions.prerequisite_en: CT capacity for same-week scans; radiology allowed to trigger the specialist referral.
interventions.owner_en: Chief radiologist together with the chief physician of primary care
interventions.owner_fi: Kuvantamisen ylilääkäri yhdessä perusterveydenhuollon johtavan lääkärin kanssa
interventions.first_step_en: Agree with radiology that a suspicious chest X-ray is followed by CT the same day, without a new referral.
interventions.first_step_fi: Sovitaan kuvantamisen kanssa, että epäilyttävän keuhkokuvan jälkeen TT tehdään samana päivänä ilman uutta lähetettä.

kpi.label_en: Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT
kpi.target_rule_en: not published in Finland: record it from this month; target 3 days or less (our target)

interventions.name_en: GP direct access to low-dose CT
interventions.what_en: Health-centre doctors can order chest CT directly for patients whose symptoms raise suspicion but do not meet urgent referral criteria, without first referring to specialist care.
interventions.what_fi: Terveyskeskuslääkäri voi tilata keuhkojen TT-kuvauksen suoraan, kun oireet herättävät epäilyn mutta kiireellisen lähetteen kriteerit eivät täyty.

cost.basis: Setup: one training round for GPs, 10 000 EUR. Yearly per 100 000 residents: about 300 extra CT scans x 200 EUR = 60 000 EUR. The number of scans is an assumption.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Baseline matters: Denmark already had fast-track referral; Finland starts from the lowest primary-care CT access in the Nordics, so the Danish null result may understate the Finnish effect. That is a hypothesis, not evidence.
interventions.owner_en: Chief physician of primary care and chief radiologist
interventions.owner_fi: Perusterveydenhuollon johtava lääkäri ja kuvantamisen ylilääkäri
interventions.first_step_en: Open chest CT ordering to health centre doctors for named symptoms and reserve the CT slots.
interventions.first_step_fi: Avataan terveyskeskuslääkäreille oikeus tilata keuhkojen TT nimetyillä oireilla ja varataan kuvausajat.

kpi.label_en: Days from first GP visit to CT
kpi.target_rule_en: not published in Finland: record it from this month; target 14 days or less (our target)

interventions.name_en: AI chest X-ray triage without added capacity
interventions.what_en: AI software flags suspicious primary-care chest X-rays so they are reported first. Included as a documented null result: the tool should not recommend it alone.
interventions.what_fi: Tekoäly nostaa epäilyttävät thorax-kuvat lausuntojonon kärkeen. Mukana dokumentoituna nollatuloksena: työkalu ei suosittele tätä yksinään.

cost.basis: Setup: integration with PACS/RIS, 50 000 EUR. Yearly licence 100 000 EUR per county. Both are assumptions; no Finnish price was found. Nationally the roadmap budgets 1 140 000 EUR for digital pathways and AI tools (measure 3.5.3).

interventions.prerequisite_en: Only worth buying together with reporting and CT capacity that can act on the flag (see same_day_cxr_ct).
interventions.owner_en: Chief radiologist; FICAN (national review of AI tools)
interventions.first_step_en: Do not buy it alone: first check how many days a flagged X-ray waits for CT.
interventions.first_step_fi: Ei hankita yksinään: selvitetään ensin, montako päivää poikkeava keuhkokuva odottaa TT-kuvausta.

kpi.label_en: Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT
kpi.target_rule_en: not published in Finland: record it

interventions.name_en: EBUS as first test, with enough bronchoscopy capacity
interventions.name_fi: EBUS ensimmäisenä tutkimuksena ja riittävä bronkoskopiakapasiteetti
interventions.what_en: Endobronchial ultrasound-guided needle biopsy as the first invasive test after CT for suspected stage I-IIIA disease, giving diagnosis and staging in one procedure, with enough EBUS lists (own or bought) to do it within a week.
interventions.what_fi: Kaikututkimusohjattu bronkoskopianäyte (EBUS) ensimmäisenä kajoavana tutkimuksena TT:n jälkeen, jolloin diagnoosi ja levinneisyys saadaan samalla kertaa; riittävästi EBUS-aikoja (omana työnä tai ostopalveluna) viikon sisään.

cost.basis: Setup: one EBUS scope and processor, 150 000 EUR (zero if the hospital already has one). Yearly: 0.3 pulmonologist (45 000) + 0.5 endoscopy nurse (30 000) for one extra weekly list. Alternative: buy the procedures from the university hospital.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Trained EBUS operators and on-site cytology; pathology must turn the sample around within a week.
interventions.first_step_en: Count how many patients waited over a week for bronchoscopy last quarter and add one EBUS list a week.
interventions.first_step_fi: Lasketaan, kuinka moni odotti bronkoskopiaa yli viikon viime neljänneksellä, ja lisätään yksi EBUS-lista viikossa.

kpi.label_en: Share of patients with stage recorded

interventions.name_en: Reflex molecular testing ordered by pathology
interventions.what_en: The pathologist starts the biomarker panel (EGFR, ALK, ROS1, PD-L1, NGS) as soon as non-small cell lung cancer is seen, without waiting for the oncologist to order it. The result now decides treatment at every stage: osimertinib or alectinib after surgery, durvalumab or osimertinib after chemoradiotherapy in stage III, and the first drug in advanced disease.
interventions.what_fi: Patologi käynnistää biomarkkeripaneelin (EGFR, ALK, ROS1, PD-L1, NGS) heti ei-pienisoluisen keuhkosyövän toteamisen jälkeen odottamatta onkologin tilausta. Tulos ohjaa nykyisin hoitoa kaikissa levinneisyysasteissa: liitännäishoito leikkauksen jälkeen, kemosädehoidon jälkeinen hoito asteessa III ja ensilinjan lääke levinneessä taudissa.

cost.basis: Setup: protocol and laboratory information system rule, 20 000 EUR. Per newly diagnosed NSCLC patient per year: about 150 EUR, assuming 10-15 % more panels run at roughly 1 000-1 500 EUR each. Panel price is an assumption.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Agreed national testing panel; molecular pathology capacity (roadmap 3.5.1 names molecular diagnostics staffing as a need).
interventions.owner_en: Chief pathologist together with the chief physician of oncology
interventions.owner_fi: Patologian ylilääkäri yhdessä syöpätautien ylilääkärin kanssa
interventions.first_step_en: The chief pathologist and the chief oncologist sign a standing order: every new non-small cell lung cancer sample goes to EGFR, ALK and PD-L1 testing the day it is diagnosed.
interventions.first_step_fi: Patologian ja syöpätautien ylilääkärit allekirjoittavat pysyväismääräyksen: jokaisesta uudesta ei-pienisoluisesta keuhkosyöpänäytteestä tehdään EGFR-, ALK- ja PD-L1-tutkimukset diagnoosipäivänä.

kpi.label_en: Days from tissue diagnosis to complete biomarker result; days to first drug treatment
kpi.label_fi: Päivät kudosdiagnoosista biomarkkerivastaukseen; päivät ensimmäiseen lääkehoitoon
kpi.target_rule_en: not published in Finland: record it from this month; target 10 working days or less (our target, no Finnish standard was found)

interventions.name_en: Plasma ctDNA test before tissue diagnosis
interventions.what_en: For patients whose imaging already shows advanced lung cancer, a blood-based ctDNA genotyping test is sent at the first specialist visit, in parallel with the biopsy.
interventions.what_fi: Kun kuvantaminen jo viittaa levinneeseen keuhkosyöpään, verestä tehtävä ctDNA-genotyypitys lähetetään ensikäynnillä rinnakkain koepalan kanssa.

cost.basis: Setup: logistics and ordering, 10 000 EUR. About 2 000 EUR per tested patient (commercial ctDNA NGS assay); price is an assumption, no Finnish list price was opened.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Useful only where tissue genotyping is the bottleneck; needs a validated assay and a rule for acting on a plasma result.
interventions.owner_en: Chief physician of oncology and the pathology/genetics laboratory
interventions.first_step_en: Agree with the laboratory which patients with suspected advanced cancer get a plasma test at the first visit.
interventions.first_step_fi: Sovitaan laboratorion kanssa, keille levinnyttä syöpää epäiltäessä otetaan plasmanäyte ensikäynnillä.

kpi.label_en: Days from first specialist visit to biomarker result
kpi.target_rule_en: not published in Finland: record it

interventions.name_en: Nurse navigator for every suspected lung cancer
interventions.what_en: A named nurse books and chases every test, calls the patient, prepares the MDT and removes waiting between steps from referral to first treatment.
interventions.what_fi: Nimetty hoitaja varaa ja varmistaa tutkimukset, pitää yhteyttä potilaaseen, valmistelee MDT-kokouksen ja poistaa odotusta vaiheiden välistä lähetteestä ensimmäiseen hoitoon.

cost.basis: Yearly: 1.0 nurse (60 000 EUR) per county, enough for roughly 150 new lung cancer patients a year; large counties need more. Setup: training, 5 000 EUR.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Authority to book across radiology, pulmonology, pathology and oncology calendars.
interventions.owner_en: Head nurses of pulmonology and oncology; director of nursing
interventions.first_step_en: Name one nurse who books every test for each new suspected lung cancer patient and calls the patient with the dates.
interventions.first_step_fi: Nimetään hoitaja, joka varaa jokaisen uuden keuhkosyöpäepäilyn tutkimukset ja ilmoittaa ajat potilaalle.

kpi.label_en: Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median)

interventions.name_en: Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers
interventions.what_en: Invite 50-74-year-old long-term heavy smokers to low-dose CT with smoking cessation support, so cancers are found before symptoms. Finland is piloting this in 2026-2028.
interventions.what_fi: Kutsutaan 50–74-vuotiaat pitkään ja paljon tupakoineet matala-annos-TT-kuvaukseen ja tupakkavieroitukseen, jolloin syöpä löytyy ennen oireita. Suomessa pilotti 2026–2028.

cost.basis: Per 100 000 residents per year: assume 2 000 eligible, 50 % take part -> 1 000 scans x 250 EUR (scan, reading, invitation) = 250 000; follow-up scans for about 10 % = 25 000; 0.4 coordinator nurse = 24 000; total about 300 000 EUR. Setup 100 000 EUR for invitation system and nodule protocol. Eligible numbers and prices are assumptions; the Finnish pilot 2026-2028 will give real ones. The roadmap gives no budget ("arviota ei tässä vaiheessa esitetä").

interventions.prerequisite_en: A national decision (Ministry, Palko). A county cannot start a screening programme alone, so it is never bought from a county budget. Needs smoking-history data to find eligible people, and CT and thoracic surgery capacity for the cancers found. Benefits arrive after years, not within a budget year.
interventions.owner_en: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery)
interventions.owner_fi: STM ja Palko (päätös), Suomen Syöpärekisteri (ohjaus), hyvinvointialue (toteutus)
interventions.first_step_en: Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site.
interventions.first_step_fi: Ei hyvinvointialueen päätös. Pyydetään STM:ltä ja Palkolta aikataulu pilotin 2026–2028 jälkeen ja tarjoudutaan pilottialueeksi.

kpi.label_en: People screened per year; share of cancers found at stage I
kpi.target_rule_en: set by the national programme after the pilot

interventions.name_en: Symptom awareness campaign (cough over three weeks)
interventions.what_en: A campaign on the English "Be Clear on Cancer" model telling people with a persistent cough to see a doctor. Weak evidence: in England the share found at stage I rose during the campaign months and faded within months, so it has to be repeated every year, and the extra GP visits and chest X-rays cost several times the advertising.
interventions.what_fi: Englannin Be Clear on Cancer -mallin mukainen kampanja, joka ohjaa pitkittyneestä yskästä kärsivät lääkäriin. Näyttö on heikko: Englannissa varhaisvaiheessa todettujen osuus nousi kampanjakuukausina ja palasi ennalleen muutamassa kuukaudessa, joten kampanja on toistettava vuosittain, ja lisäkäynnit ja keuhkokuvat maksavat moninkertaisesti mainontaan verrattuna.

cost.basis: Per 100 000 residents per year. Advertising: 7 100 EUR (roadmap measure 1.3.2 budgets 400 000 EUR nationally; 400 000 / 5.6 million x 100 000). Extra health-care use during and after the campaign, our assumption: 300 extra GP visits x 125 EUR = 37 500; 250 extra chest X-rays x 60 EUR = 15 000; 50 extra CT scans x 200 EUR = 10 000. Total 69 600 EUR, repeated every year because the effect fades. Only the advertising figure comes from a source.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Primary care must be able to see the extra patients quickly; in England urgent referrals rose during the campaign.
interventions.owner_en: FICAN and the Cancer Society (national campaign); county communications and primary care (local delivery)
interventions.owner_fi: FICAN ja Syöpäjärjestöt (kansallinen kampanja); hyvinvointialueen viestintä ja perusterveydenhuolto (alueellinen toteutus)
interventions.first_step_en: Before buying advertising, check that health centres can see the extra patients within a week.
interventions.first_step_fi: Ennen mainonnan ostamista varmistetaan, että terveyskeskukset pystyvät ottamaan lisäpotilaat vastaan viikon sisällä.

kpi.label_en: Share of cancers found at stage I
kpi.target_rule_en: not published per county (stage is missing for nearly half of patients): record it

interventions.name_en: Rapid diagnostic centre for non-specific symptoms
interventions.what_en: One referral route for patients with serious but non-specific symptoms (weight loss, fatigue, abnormal bloods): a small team does bloods, CT and review within days, on the Danish NSSC pathway model.
interventions.what_fi: Yksi lähetereitti potilaille, joilla on vakavia mutta epämääräisiä oireita (laihtuminen, väsymys, poikkeavat verikokeet): pieni tiimi tekee verikokeet, TT:n ja arvion päivien sisällä Tanskan mallin mukaan.

cost.basis: Yearly: 0.5 internist/GP (75 000) + 1.0 nurse (60 000) + about 300 CT scans x 200 EUR (60 000) = 195 000 EUR. Setup 50 000 EUR.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Standard referral criteria (roadmap 2.5.2) and guaranteed imaging slots.
interventions.owner_en: Chief physician of primary care and chief of internal/general medicine
interventions.owner_fi: Perusterveydenhuollon johtava lääkäri ja sisätautien/yleislääketieteen ylilääkäri
interventions.first_step_en: Name the unit and the doctor who take patients with unexplained weight loss or fatigue within a week.
interventions.first_step_fi: Nimetään yksikkö ja lääkäri, joka ottaa selittämättömästä laihtumisesta tai väsymyksestä kärsivät potilaat vastaan viikon sisällä.

kpi.target_rule_en: not published in Finland: record it

interventions.name_en: Faster access to a doctor in primary care, with pulmonologist e-consultation
interventions.name_fi: Nopeampi pääsy lääkärille perusterveydenhuollossa ja keuhkolääkärin sähköinen konsultaatio
interventions.what_en: Extra doctor capacity and continuity (personal doctor model) so a patient with lung symptoms meets a doctor within a week, plus a same-week electronic consultation line from GP to pulmonologist.
interventions.what_fi: Lisää lääkäriresurssia ja hoidon jatkuvuutta (omalääkärimalli), jotta keuhko-oireinen pääsee lääkärille viikossa, sekä yleislääkärin ja keuhkolääkärin välinen sähköinen konsultaatio saman viikon aikana.

cost.basis: Per 100 000 residents per year: 1.0 extra GP (130 000 EUR) + 0.1 pulmonologist for e-consultations (15 000 EUR). Setup 20 000 EUR. The roadmap funds this through the national personal doctor programme (measure 2.5.1), no separate budget.

interventions.prerequisite_en: Doctors to hire; benefit is not lung-specific, so most of the value lies outside this model.
interventions.owner_en: Chief physician of primary care; Ministry of Social Affairs and Health (personal doctor programme)
interventions.first_step_en: Open an e-consultation line from health centre doctors to a pulmonologist with an answer within two working days.
interventions.first_step_fi: Avataan terveyskeskuslääkäreille e-konsultaatio keuhkolääkärille; vastaus kahden arkipäivän kuluessa.

kpi.label_en: Share of primary care visits that waited over 7 days
kpi.label_fi: Yli 7 päivää odottaneiden osuus perusterveydenhuollon käynneistä
kpi.target_rule_en: at or below the national share

interventions.name_en: Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists
interventions.name_fi: Viikoittainen etäkokous, jossa yliopistosairaalan erikoislääkärit käyvät läpi jokaisen I–III-asteen potilaan
interventions.what_en: Every patient whose cancer has not spread (stage I-III) is discussed by video with the university hospital lung team (surgeon, radiotherapy doctor, oncologist) before anyone decides against treatment that aims to cure. Today a county hospital can decide alone.
interventions.what_fi: Jokainen potilas, jonka syöpä ei ole levinnyt (aste I–III), käsitellään etäyhteydellä yliopistosairaalan keuhkosyöpätyöryhmässä (kirurgi, sädehoitolääkäri, onkologi) ennen kuin parantavasta hoidosta luovutaan. Nyt keskussairaala voi päättää asiasta yksin.

cost.basis: Setup: video MDT room and image sharing with the university hospital, 30 000 EUR. Yearly: 0.3 coordinator nurse (18 000), 0.1 specialist doctor to prepare cases (15 000), university hospital MDT time bought (12 000). All assumptions.

interventions.prerequisite_en: The university hospital agrees a weekly video slot. Roadmap 3.1.2 expects regional pathway responsibilities to be agreed in collaborative-area contracts by 2028.
interventions.owner_en: Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT
interventions.first_step_en: Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there.
interventions.first_step_fi: Pyydetään yliopistosairaalalta kiinteä viikoittainen etäkokousaika ja listataan viime kuussa todetut I–III-asteen potilaat, joita siellä ei käsitelty.
